question: Approve the revised ideation: retire the legacy TeamCreate surface and bind the template slot, no xfail?

artifacts.summary: Cycle 2 dropped the xfail per the gate and answered the variance puzzle with direct stream evidence. Pulled both transcripts — red 32189720211 and green main 32040773989: the green call emitted all six template fields; the red emitted five, dropping ONLY subagent_type while resolving {worker_key} to spacedock-ensign in the same call. So the FO possessed the value and dropped the unbound parameter. Not environment (identical bytes across CI-main pass, CI-tip fail, and two local passes) and not missing knowledge (the value was in context three ways). Across both calls: 11/11 explicit fields correct, 1/2 on the sole unbound slot — the split lands exactly on the bound/unbound line. Binding removes the choice point. Stated with its honest bound: sampling can still defy an explicit literal, and a post-binding red would be fresh evidence filed then. Bonus finding: both live FOs, told only 'team mode', reached for the advertised --team-name with fabricated names, so removing the flag closes an observed mis-dispatch path rather than a theoretical one. Surface net -500 across ~47 files (down from 49; the live test and registry are no longer touched).
